title: Judge Borderline Tier-1 Response
description: Structured response from the borderline tier-1 judge call site (#1 per spec §6.9). Coach consumes this to decide whether to pass, respawn, or annotate when tier-1 returns ambiguous results.

decision.description: The routing decision. 'pass' continues without action; 'respawn' triggers the spawn-feedback path; 'annotate' posts a PR annotation and continues.

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision, used to gate respawn vs annotate deterministically.
